buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Tender Inviting Authority This tender is issued by the Director, ICMR-National Institute of Translational Virology and AIDS Research ( NITVAR), Pune, Maharashtra, for procurement of the HIV BLOT 2.2 WESTERN BLOT KITS WITH CAT CODE N O. 0711031036 basis as per the technical specifications detailed in the Specification Document attached u nder the Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC. 2. Bid Security Declaration In accordance with Rule 170 of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, the Bid Security Declaration shall be applicable .MSEs registered under the applicable MSME Procurement Policy and DPIIT-recognized Startu ps shall be exempt from submission of EMD, subject to fulfillment of the applicable eligibility conditions an d submission of valid supporting documents, wherever applicable. 3. Eligibility Criteria The bidder shall be either: a. The Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM)/Original Manufacturer of the offered consumable(s); or b. An authorized distributor/dealer/agent of the OEM/Original Manufacturer. Where the bidder is not the OEM/Original Manufacturer, a valid authorization certificate issued by the OEM/ Original Manufacturer shall be submitted along with the bid, wherever applicable. 4. One Bid per Bidder Each bidder shall submit only one bid against this tender. Submission of multiple bids by the same bidder, either directly or indirectly, may result in disqualification in accordance with the applicable GeM terms and conditions. 5. Right to Accept, Reject or Cancel the Tender The Director, ICMR-NITVAR reserves the right to accept or reject any bid and/or cancel the tender, in whole or in part, at any stage, in accordance with applicable Government rules, procurement guidelines and GeM terms and conditions. 6. Inspection and Testing ICMR-NITVAR or its designated representative reserves the right to inspect and/or test the supplied consu mables, wherever considered necessary, to verify conformity with the prescribed specifications, quality req uirements, quantity, batch/lot details, shelf life and other contractual requirements. The supplier shall pro vide all necessary assistance and relevant documentation required for such inspection and/or testing. 7. Acceptance of Supplies The supplied consumables shall be subject to inspection and verification upon receipt at ICMR-NITVAR.Acc eptance shall be accorded only after verification of the quantity, specifications, quality, packaging, batch/l ot details, expiry date/residual shelf life and other prescribed requirements.Any material found to be dama ged, defective, expired, short-supplied, incorrectly supplied or otherwise not conforming to the prescribed specifications shall be liable for rejection and replacement by the supplier at no additional cost to ICMR-NI TVAR. 8. Packing and Transportation The consumables shall be suitably packed to protect them from damage, contamination, deterioration, mo isture, temperature variation and other risks during handling, transportation and storage. The supplier shal l ensure that the packaging complies with applicable statutory, regulatory and manufacturer requirements. The material shall be delivered to the consignee location specified in the GeM Contract. Where the nature of the consumable requires specific transportation or storage conditions, the supplier shall ensure complia nce with such conditions throughout transportation and delivery.

9. Replacement of Defective/Damaged Material Any consumable found to be defective, damaged, contaminated, deteriorated, expired, short-supplied or o therwise not conforming to the prescribed specifications shall be replaced by the supplier at no additional cost to ICMR-NITVAR. The replacement shall be made within the period specified by ICMR-NITVAR. 10. Payment Terms 100% payment shall be released after successful delivery, inspection and acceptance of the consumables by ICMR-NITVAR and submission of all required documents, subject to applicable statutory deductions. The following documents shall be submitted for processing of payment, as applicable: a. Copy of Purchase Order/GeM Contract; b. Tax Invoice; c. Delivery Challan/Consignee Receipt; d. Inspection/Acceptance Certificate, wherever applicable; and e. Any other document required under the GeM Bid/Contract. 11. Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) Performance Bank Guarantee shall be applicable as per the terms and conditions specified in the GeM Bid/ Contract and applicable Government rules. 12. Liquidated Damages In the event of delay in delivery attributable to the supplier, Liquidated Damages shall be levied in accord ance with the provisions of the applicable GeM Contract, subject to the maximum permissible limit prescrib ed therein. 13. GST and Other Taxes GST and all other applicable taxes, duties, levies and statutory charges shall be governed by the prevailing Government of India rules and regulations. Unless specifically provided otherwise in the GeM Bid, the rates quoted by the bidder shall be inclusive of all applicable charges up to the consignee location. 14. Blacklisted/Debarred Firms Bidders who, as on the date of bid submission, are blacklisted, debarred, suspended or otherwise prohibite d from participating in procurement by any Government Organization or by the GeM Portal shall be ineligi ble to participate in this GeM Bid. The bidder shall comply with all applicable declarations and requirement s prescribed under the GeM terms and conditions in this regard. 15. Delivery The complete quantity of the consumables shall be delivered at the following consignee location: ICMR-Nat ional Institute of Translational Virology and AIDS Research (NITVAR), Pune, Maharashtra. The complete sup ply shall be delivered within the delivery period specified in the GeM Contract. 16. Make in India (MII) Policy The bidder shall comply with the applicable provisions of the Government of India Make in India (MII) Policy and other applicable Government procurement policies, as amended from time to time. 17. Technical Compliance and Documents The bidder shall submit the following documents along with the bid: a. Point-wise compliance against each specification mentioned in the attached Specification Document; b. Product catalogue/brochure/data sheet, wherever applicable; c. OEM/Manufacturer Authorization Certificate, wherever applicable; d. Details of make, model, product code/catalogue number, wherever applicable; and e. Any other supporting technical literature or document specifically required under the bid.

Failure to submit the required technical documents may result in the bid being considered non-responsive, subject to applicable GeM provisions. 18. Discrepancy Between GeM Bid and Specification Document In the event of any discrepancy, inconsistency or conflict between the specifications mentioned in the GeM Bid and those specified in the Specification Document attached under the Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC, t he provisions of the Specification Document shall prevail, to the extent permissible under applicable GeM t erms and Government rules. 19. Contract Splitting Contract splitting shall not be applicable for this tender. The complete quantity shall be considered as one procurement requirement and shall be supplied in accordance with the GeM Contract, subject applicable G eM provisions. 20. Dispute Resolution Any dispute arising out of or in connection with the contract shall, in the first instance, be resolved amicabl y through mutual consultation between the parties. In the event that the dispute cannot be resolved amica bly, the same shall be dealt with in accordance with the applicable contractual provisions, GeM terms and conditions and applicable laws of India. The jurisdiction for arbitration and/or legal proceedings, to the exte nt permissible under the applicable contractual provisions, shall be Pune, Maharashtra. 21. Precedence of Buyer Added ATC Conditions In the event of any discrepancy or inconsistency between the standard GeM Bid Terms and Conditions and the conditions specified in this Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC, the provisions of this Buyer Added Bid Specif ic ATC shall prevail to the extent permissible under the applicable GeM terms and conditions and Governm ent rules. 22. Compliance with Statutory and Regulatory Requirements The bidder/supplier shall comply with all applicable statutory, regulatory and legal requirements relating to the manufacture, supply, packaging, transportation, storage and delivery of the consumables. Where appli cable, the supplier shall ensure that the supplied consumables are accompanied by the requisite certificat es, licences, batch/lot details, test certificates, product literature or other documents prescribed under app licable laws, regulations or the Specification Document. 23. General Conditions Any matter not specifically covered under this Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC shall be governed by the appl icable GeM General Terms and Conditions, bid-specific terms and conditions, General Financial Rules (GFR) , 2017, Government of India procurement policies and other applicable statutory provisions, as amended fr om time to time. . 2.
